## Summary

Describe the user-facing and technical change.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm validate:env`
- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test:unit`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e`

## Review checklist

- [ ] I reviewed the desktop and mobile experience.
- [ ] I did not add a secret, JWT, cookie value, or personal data to source, tests, logs, or documentation.
- [ ] I documented any User or History API contract change.
- [ ] I included the relevant task or issue link.
